about_the_game:
About This Software

Artists Painting on your desktop wallpaper in real time? YES!

SuprSketch is a real-time art wallpaper app powered only by HUMAN Artists. SuprSketch connects you to real artists who broadcast their brushstrokes as they draw live, at any moment. Your desktop wallpaper updates whenever your selected artist decides to send updates to their online art installation.

No AI. Just real artists. I think we are making this very clear.  

How does it work?

  • Artist turn on the SuprSketch plugin to capture their brush strokes – Every update on Photoshop or Krita is mirrored to their online SuprSketch art installation.

  • Art updates are sent to SuprSketch secure cloud servers – All art is held and protected to the highest standards.

  • New brush strokes then update the Artist's Art Installation

  • User's connected to the art installation are sent brush strokes

  • The SuprSketch app receives the latest brush strokes and updates your desktop wallpaper in real time

    This whole process happens in less than 3 seconds. From plugin to viewers.

Key Features

  • Live Wallpaper Engine – Watch artists draw live as your wallpaper mirrors their drawing pad.

  • Museum-grade Real-Time Streaming – Zero-compression SuprCanvas™ technology renders pixel-perfect art directly to your desktop. 

  • Human Artists Only – All content is handmade. We will keep saying this. We are a human only art technology. We will always support whatever our artists want. They are our highest priority.

  • Lightweight & Secure – Minimal system usage. Authenticated streams. Instant updates.

  • Auto Update Backgrounds – When the artist goes offline, their art installation doesnt turn off. It is always active, waiting for updates from the artist.

  • Multiple Artists – Choose from a curated list of verified artist, each with a unique style and professional backgrounds. Anyone with 'Supr' in their name is part of our Suprsketch team. It is mandatory for every member of our team to maintain an art installation so that we can test our technology for ourselves.

Who’s it for?

  • Digital art lovers

  • Digital Artists and Creatives

  • Fans of apps like Wallpaper Engine

  • Anyone who wants access to the most innovative art technology

  • Anyone who wants the greatest desktop environment

Built By Artists, For Artists

As an art-tech company, SuprSketch Corp. is committed to empowering creators. Artists retain full ownership of their work and are never replaced by algorithms. We're building a future where your desktop is personal and alive.

No machine learning is allowed access to this software or any data passed over the SuprSketch ecosystem. We do not sell any artist or user data. We never will.

Join the future of Desktop Art

Download the Windows app, select your favorite artists, and turn your screen into a gallery that never sleeps.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2 GHz dual-core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

short_description: An art based wallpaper app. Live-streamed art directly to your desktop wallpaper. SuprSketch lets real human artists paint on your wallpaper in real time, turning your wallpaper into a living art installation.
